payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each start index i, track first occurrence of each distinct value after each occurrence of arr[i] (resetting on arr[i]); count per value across gaps to compute max alternating length.
payload.rationale: Solution is a complete search scanning all pairs (i, x) by counting in intervals, not DP. Forced to pick DP subtype from candidates, but actual mechanism is combinatorial counting, not state-based DP.
